_comment: CENTUM AI Office — flat floor plan. Adding a block here creates agents/<id>/ and the next free seat. Generated by tools/build_office_data.py; the pixel engine reads slots from app/data/office.json.
name: CENTUM AI Office

layout._growth: an 11th agent adds a third 5-seat table (table-c); 16th adds table-d, etc.

desks.role: ONEWORD / QBANK — one-word banks, MCQ JSON, notes
QA / CENTUM BUILD — gate, audits, test support

lights.rule: honest — a desk says 'working' only with work evidence (a log line about the task / a file / progress). Heartbeats show 'at the desk'.
lights.note: Every age and light is recomputed in the browser from raw timestamps, so a quiet desk dims without a rebuild.

app_data_note: app/data/office.json holds only desks, tasks, start prompts — ~11 KB. Reports, chat, logs live in the repo.
